s.note: Tyler's crew rolls in from Arkansas. Cornmeal-crusted okra and a smoky dip.
s.how: Stir the mayonnaise, chilli sauce, tomato sauce, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon into the comeback sauce. Soak the okra in the buttermilk, then toss it in the cornmeal, flour, paprika and a big pinch of salt. Fry in batches at 180C until crisp and golden, then drain. Salt straight away and serve hot with the sauce.

s.note: The fire tornado heads for El Reno. Smashed beef, crisp onions, American cheese.
s.how: Roll the beef into 8 balls and season well. Heat a heavy pan very hot, add a ball, pile on a handful of onions and smash flat through the onions with a spatula. Cook until the edges crust, flip so the onions fry underneath, and lay on a slice of cheese. Toast the buttered buns, then build with pickle and mustard and serve hot.

m.note: Kate goes home to her mum's farm. Crumbed steak, pepper gravy, mash and greens.
m.how: Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with the butter and a splash of the milk. Season the flour with garlic powder, pepper and salt; whisk the eggs with the buttermilk. Dip the steaks in flour, egg, then flour again, pressing it on well. Shallow-fry in hot oil until deep golden, about 3 minutes a side, and drain. Pour off all but 2 tbsp of oil, whisk in 2 tbsp flour, then the rest of the milk, and simmer into a peppery gravy. Wilt the silverbeet and serve with the steak, mash and gravy.
shop: 150g plain flour, plus 2 tbsp for the gravy@Pantry

m.note: Riggs buys up the storm-wrecked land. Slow-smoked beef with jalapeno slaw.
m.how: Rub the brisket all over with the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and salt. Sit it in a roasting dish with the stock, cover tightly and cook at 150C until it pulls apart. Rest, then slice or shred and toss with the barbecue sauce and some of the pan juices. Mix the cabbage, carrot, jalapenos, mayo and vinegar into a slaw. Pile the brisket and slaw into the rolls.

w.note: Tyler takes Kate to the rodeo. Fried batter swirls, icing sugar, berries.
w.how: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, eggs, milk and vanilla into a smooth pouring batter. Heat the oil to 180C in a wide pan. Pour a cup of batter through a funnel or a squeeze bottle in a loose swirl and fry until golden, turning once. Drain, dust heavily with icing sugar and top with strawberries.

d.note: Tyler says if you feel it chase it. Bourbon, fresh lemonade and a mint sprig.
d.how: Stir the lemon juice and sugar until dissolved, then add the water. Fill 4 jars with ice, add 40ml bourbon each, top with lemonade and a mint sprig.

shopping: 150g plain flour, plus 2 tbsp for the gravy@Pantry
